story.titleZh: 50年前最后一位女性车手参加F1大奖赛
story.summaryZh: 今天距离女性车手最后一次参加F1大奖赛已过去50年。1976年奥地利大奖赛上，莱拉·隆巴迪完成了她的最后一场F1比赛。

story.originalTitle: History: 50 years since the last time a woman started a Formula 1 race
story.summaryEn: Today marks 50 years since the last time a woman competed in a Formula 1 Grand Prix. Lella Lombardi made her final F1 start at the 1976 Austrian Grand Prix.
detailZh: 今天，距离上一次有女性车手出现在大奖赛发车格上已过去五十年，等待F1下一位女性车手的漫长历程又迎来了一个里程碑。
50年前的今天举行的1976年奥地利大奖赛，标志着女性车手第15次也是最后一次出现在发车格上。这位车手就是莱拉·隆巴迪，她占据了这些发车中的绝大多数（仅三次除外）。
隆巴迪代表RAM车队驾驶，她驾驶着已有一年车龄的布拉汉姆BT44B赛车，在25辆赛车的发车格上排在第24位。她此前在纽博格林北环赛道的上一站比赛中未能获得参赛资格，但两周后参赛车辆减少了三辆，尤其是法拉利的尼基·劳达，他在一场大火事故中受了近乎致命的伤。
隆巴迪最终以第12名完赛，尽管落后冠军约翰·沃森四圈。她领先队友洛里斯·凯塞尔六圈，不过凯塞尔因燃油接头故障在维修站停留了很长时间。
这标志着隆巴迪F1生涯的不幸终结，而那个赛季开始时原本充满希望。一年前，她成为第一位（也是至今唯一一位）在大奖赛中得分的女性。著名的是，她在蒙锥克公园缩短的西班牙大奖赛中获得第六名，赢得半分。
同年晚些时候，她在令人生畏的纽博格林举行的德国大奖赛中获得第七名，但这一成绩鲜为人知。隆巴迪在沃特金斯格伦的最后一站转投弗兰克·威廉姆斯车队，但她的FW03赛车在暖胎圈离合器故障。
1976年她代表马奇车队参赛，但仅一场比赛后车队就替换了她，因为她的赞助未能到位，而罗尼·彼得森从莲花车队转投而来。隆巴迪在RAM车队重新出现，但奥地利站是她唯一一次成功获得参赛资格。
遗憾的是，此后很少有女性有机会加入隆巴迪和玛丽亚·特蕾莎·德·菲利皮斯的行列，成为F1仅有的女性车手。德西蕾·威尔逊在布兰兹哈奇赢得了一场非锦标赛F1比赛，但在有机会参加顶级赛事时，她驾驶的赛车竞争力远远不足。迪维娜·加利卡在七十年代也未能让自己的赛车进入发车格。
最后一位尝试获得大奖赛参赛资格的女性是1992年的乔瓦娜·阿马蒂，同样驾驶布拉汉姆赛车，不过是为当时陷入困境的厂队效力。鉴于她缺乏经验以及车队糟糕的财务状况，她四次尝试均未能获得参赛资格并不令人意外。
此后唯一一位参加过大奖赛周末的女性是苏茜·沃尔夫，十多年前她曾为威廉姆斯车队四次参加练习赛。但如果F1能够再次让一位女性进入发车格，很可能要归功于沃尔夫，因为她现在领导着F1学院，这是一个全女性赛车类别，作为F1的支援系列赛运行，让女性车手驾驶由大奖赛车队支持的赛车。随着F1现在认真努力推广女性车手，希望她们中的更多人能进入F3、F2并最终进入顶级赛事只是时间问题。
但这需要时间，正如F1首席执行官斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利所承认的那样。“现实地说，除非有某种像流星撞地球一样的事情发生，否则我看不到未来五年内有女孩进入F1，”他说。“这非常不可能。”
detailEn: The long wait for Formula 1’s next female racer reaches another milestone today as five decades have passed since the last time a grand prix grid featured a woman.

The 1976 Austrian Grand Prix, held 50 years ago today, marked the 15th and final time a woman appeared on the grid. The racer in question was Lella Lombardi, who accounts for all bar three of those starts.

Driving for RAM Racing, Lombardi qualified her year-old Brabham BT44B 24th on the 25-car grid. She had failed to make the cut for the previous round at the Nurburgring Nordschleife, but two weeks later three fewer entrants appeared, notably that of Ferrari’s Niki Lauda who had suffered near-fatal injuries in a fiery crash.

Lombardi reached the chequered flag in 12th, albeit four laps behind winner John Watson. She was six laps ahead of team mate Loris Kessel, though he spent a lengthy time in the pits while a fault with a fuel union was fixed.

This marked an unfortunate end to Lombardi’s F1 career after a season which had begun promisingly. A year earlier she became the first (and still only) woman to score points in a grand prix. Famously, she took half a point for finishing sixth in the shortened Spanish Grand Prix at Montjuich Park.

Her seventh-placed finish later the same year in the German Grand Prix on the daunting Nurburgring is less well-remembered. Lombardi switched to Frank Williams’ team for the final race at Watkins Glen but her FW03’s clutch failed on the formation lap.

She started 1976 at March but the team replaced her after just one race as her sponsorship failed to materialise and Ronnie Peterson switched teams from Lotus. Lombardi reappeared at RAM, but the Austrian race would be the only time she managed to qualify.

Lamentably few women have since had the opportunity to join Lombardi and Maria Teresa de Filippis as F1’s only female racers. Desire Wilson won a non-championship F1 race at Brands Hatch but laboured with much less competitive equipment when given the chance to compete at the top flight. Nor did Divina Galica manage to get her car onto the grid in the seventies.

The last woman to attempt to qualify for a grand prix was Giovanna Amati in 1992, also in a Brabham, albeit for the now-beleaguered works team. Given her lack of experience and the team’s dire financial situation, her failure to qualify in four attempts came as no surprise.

The only other woman to participate in a grand prix weekend since then was Susie Wolff who made four practice appearances for Williams over a decade ago. But if F1 ever manages to get another woman onto the grid it will likely have Wolff to thank, as she now heads up F1 Academy, the all-female racing category which runs as a support series to F1 and puts female racers in cars backed by grand prix teams. With F1 now making a serious effort to promote female racers, it is hopefully only a matter of time until more of them reach Formula 3, Formula 2 and eventually the top flight.

But it will take time, as F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali has acknowledged. “Realistically speaking, I don’t see, unless something that will be like a sort of meteor coming into the earth, a girl in F1 in the next five years,” he said. “That is very unlikely.”
keyPointsZh: 隆巴迪在1976年奥地利大奖赛获得第12名，落后冠军约翰·沃森四圈。
她曾在1975年西班牙大奖赛获得第六名，成为唯一一位在F1大奖赛中得分的女性。
自她之后，仅乔瓦娜·阿马蒂在1992年尝试过参加F1大奖赛，但未能通过排位赛。
keyPointsEn: Lombardi finished 12th at the 1976 Austrian Grand Prix, four laps behind winner John Watson.
She scored half a point for finishing sixth in the shortened 1975 Spanish Grand Prix, becoming the only woman to score points in F1.
Since then, only Giovanna Amati attempted to qualify for a Grand Prix in 1992, but failed to make the grid.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Cadillac F1 goes full Texas with new Tommy Hilfiger collection for US Grand Prix
relatedItems.summaryEn: The Cadillac Formula 1 Team and its partner Tommy Hilfiger have released a Texas-themed clothing collection ahead of the United States Grand Prix. The collection went on sale on Tuesday earlier this week.
detailZh: 凯迪拉克F1以全新汤米·希尔费格系列在美国大奖赛上尽显得克萨斯风情
凯迪拉克与汤米·希尔费格发布了一个以得克萨斯为灵感的五件式牛仔（denim）系列
瓦尔特利·博塔斯，凯迪拉克F1车队——图片由汤米·希尔费格提供
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计，以及让赛车超越运动本身的故事。
凯迪拉克一级方程式车队及其合作伙伴汤米·希尔费格在奥斯汀美国大奖赛前发布了一个德克萨斯主题的服装系列，这让我们所有人都兴奋不已。
汤米·希尔费格与凯迪拉克一级方程式车队的奥斯汀系列于本周二早些时候开售。但这并不是这两个品牌第一次推出与比赛相关的产品。他们已经在同一城市系列中推出了迈阿密和墨西哥系列，并且还计划在11月推出拉斯维加斯系列。
不出意外的话，牛仔布是这些单品的核心，它们带有镀铬细节和汤米·希尔费格红白蓝配色的V形美国国旗。
男士可以购买基于经典卡车司机风格的浅色水洗牛仔夹克。女士则有一件带银色箔涂层的牛仔背心。一件T恤、一件背心和一顶牛仔帽让这个系列更加让人难以拒绝。你知道还有什么同样让人难以拒绝吗？可以看到凯迪拉克车手瓦尔特利·博塔斯在日落时分向镜头举起一顶牛仔帽，背上印有V形旗帜图案。
你还需要什么来说服你？
瓦尔特利·博塔斯，凯迪拉克F1车队——由汤米·希尔费格提供
“在我们的美国根源上增添一点乐趣”
汤米·希尔费格首席设计官李·霍尔曼表示，设计师们从该品牌最受欢迎的两件单品入手。
他说：“我们从 Tommy 衣橱中的标志性单品——牛仔夹克和白 T 恤——入手，并研究了如何以奥斯汀的城市气质为灵感对它们进行重新演绎。”
“关键在于把熟悉的单品赋予全新的视角，同时坚守我们经典美式酷感的品牌基因。”
凯迪拉克一级方程式车队首席品牌顾问卡西迪·托里斯表示，在得克萨斯州举行的这场比赛让两个品牌都有了发挥空间。
“奥斯汀让我们有机会在美国根源上玩得更尽兴一些，”托里斯说，“这是为比赛周末打造的粉丝服饰，但设计上力求在围场之外也能长久穿着。”
汤米·希尔费格是凯迪拉克的官方服装和车迷服饰合作伙伴，车手塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯——博塔斯的队友——也是该品牌的全球男装大使。奥斯汀站是美国车队本赛季继五月初迈阿密大奖赛之后的第二个主场比赛，佩雷斯期待能在离家更近的地方驾驶。
“我们距离能够与前车竞争还差大约一秒到一秒半，我认为我们现在真正需要的是一辆更强的赛车，”佩雷斯在新加坡站后表示。“其他一切都在按预期推进，我相信我们作为一个团队会达到目标。我非常期待奥斯汀和墨西哥，我们的两场主场比赛。
“奥斯汀是车队的主场，墨西哥对我而言将格外特别，在家乡观众面前比赛并迎来第300场大奖赛。那将是一个非常特别的周末。”
凯迪拉克在首个赛季仍在等待它的首个积分。
detailEn: Cadillac F1 goes full Texas with new Tommy Hilfiger collection for US Grand Prix
Cadillac and Tommy Hilfiger have unveiled a five-piece denim collection inspired by Texas
Valtteri Bottas, Cadillac F1 team - courtesy of Tommy Hilfiger
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
The Cadillac Formula 1 Team and its partner Tommy Hilfiger have released a Texas-themed clothing collection ahead of the United States Grand Prix in Austin, and it's making us all kinds of excited.

The Tommy Hilfiger x Cadillac Formula 1 Team Austin collection went on sale on Tuesday earlier this week. But this isn't the first time the two brands have released something in connection with a race. They have already released Miami and Mexico collections in the same city series, and a Las Vegas drop is also planned for November.
Denim, maybe unsurprisingly, is the heart of these pieces, which carry chrome detailing and a chevron-shaped American flag in Tommy Hilfiger's red, white and blue.

Men can buy a light-wash denim jacket based on the classic trucker style. For women, there's a denim vest with a silver foil coating. A T-shirt, a tank top and a denim cap make the range even harder to say no to. And do you know what else does the same? Cadillac driver Valtteri Bottas can be seen tipping a cowboy hat to the camera at sunset, with the chevron flag design across his back.
What more do you need to persuade you?
Valtteri Bottas, Cadillac F1 team - courtesy of Tommy Hilfiger
"A little more fun with our American roots"
Lee Holman, Tommy Hilfiger's chief design officer, said the designers started with two of the brand's most popular pieces.
"We started with icons of the Tommy wardrobe – the denim jacket and the white T-shirt – and looked at how we could rework them inspired by the character of Austin," he said.
"It's about taking familiar pieces and giving them a fresh point of view, while staying grounded in our classic American cool DNA."
Cassidy Towriss, chief brand adviser for the Cadillac Formula 1 Team, said the race in Texas gave both brands room to play.
"Austin gives us a chance to have a little more fun with our American roots," Towriss said. "It's fanwear made for race weekend, but designed to live well beyond the paddock."

Tommy Hilfiger is Cadillac's official apparel and fanwear partner, with driver Sergio Perez, Bottas's team-mate, also the brand's global menswear ambassador. With the Austin race being the American team's second home race of the season after the Miami Grand Prix earlier this season in early May, Perez is looking forward to driving a little closer to home.

“We are still lacking around one to one-and-a-half seconds to be able to compete with the cars ahead, and I think what we really need now is a stronger car underneath us," Perez said following his Singapore campaign. "Everything else has been progressing as expected, and I’m confident we will get there as a team. I’m really looking forward to Austin and Mexico, our two home races.
"Austin for the team, and Mexico will be particularly special for me, racing in front of my home crowd and reaching 300 grands prix. It’s going to be a very special weekend.”
Cadillac is still waiting for its first points in its debut season.
